titulo: Stories echo: What kind of friend are you? Honestly.
alt: four colored cards labeled A to D. What kind of friend are you? Honestly. Everyone's been A at least once. A: Replies in 3 days: “omg sorry”. B: Only texts when something's wrong. C: Plans everything. Resents everyone. D: Says little. Always shows up.
